$comment: No-regression floors for QueenZone.Mobile (#871 Option A). Changing these values is an explicit, reviewable edit. Do not put thresholds only in package.json jest config — Jest is one of two suites. Contracts (#869) and Maestro (#872/#883) stay out of these totals.
notes: Floors are the 2026-08-24 measured merged totals (Jest collectCoverageFrom universe, Node V8 hits overlaid onto matching Istanbul lines) rounded down to one decimal to absorb single-line jitter. Branch stays on the Jest/Istanbul map because V8 BRDA keys do not overlay. Changed-line starts at 70% because the #833 component/hook harness can cover TSX; it is a new-code bar, not a copy of the web C# 70%. Later ratchets are separate PRs.
